title: Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子) phantom blade zero boss

facts.label: Location
facts.value: The Lady's Shrine - end of the region

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子) is an optional encounter in Mountain of Imprisonment, found at The Lady's Shrine - end of the region. Beating it yields Flying Guillotine, Void Bloom Fan.

sections.title: Where to Find the Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子)
sections.content:
Location: The Lady's Shrine - end of the region.

Appears in: Mountain of Imprisonment.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: How to Beat the Huangxing, the Kunlun Renegade (荒行子)
sections.content:
What works

  • Optional boss at the end of the Mountain of Imprisonment; the Crossroads of Blood trophy is the only thing pointing at him.
  • The fight shares a bell with Jade-Face but not a reward table - Huangxing drops the Flying Guillotine and the Void Bloom Fan.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 50 of 60 in the progression order, in Mountain of Imprisonment. Before it: Jade-Face (玉面郎君). After it: Yu Ding, No. 12 Crescent Blade Puppet. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
